fullPassage: There’s a lot of scientific evidence demonstrating that focused attention leads to the reshaping of the brain. In animals rewarded for noticing sound (to hunt or to avoid being hunted for example), we find much larger auditory centers in the brain. In animals rewarded for sharp eyesight, the visual areas are larger. Brain scans of violinists provide more evidence, showing dramatic growth and expansion in regions of the cortex that represent the left hand, which has to finger the strings precisely, often at very high speed. Other studies have shown that the hippocampus, which is vital for spatial memory, is enlarged in taxi drivers. The point is that the physical architecture of the brain changes according to where we direct our attention and what we practice doing.

questions.passage: There’s a lot of scientific evidence demonstrating that focused attention leads to the reshaping of the brain. In animals rewarded for noticing sound (to hunt or to avoid being hunted for example), we find much larger auditory centers in the brain. In animals rewarded for sharp eyesight, the visual areas are larger. Brain scans of violinists provide more evidence, showing dramatic growth and expansion in regions of the cortex that represent the left hand, which has to finger the strings precisely, often at very high speed. Other studies have shown that the hippocampus, which is vital for spatial memory, is enlarged in taxi drivers. The point is that <u>the physical architecture of the brain</u> changes according to where we direct our attention and what we practice doing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 the physical architecture of the brain이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: architecture(건축물)를 비유로 써서, 뇌 부위의 크기·연결 등 물리적 구조를 뜻함
det.analysis:
✅ ① 뇌 각 부위의 크기와 조직 방식 등 물리적 구조: architecture는 '건축물'이 아니라 비유적으로 뇌가 어떻게 구성·연결되어 있는지를 가리킵니다. 앞서 청각 중추·시각 영역·해마의 크기가 변한다고 했으므로 물리적 구조가 맞습니다 ←정답

❌ ② 뇌를 설계한 사람이 그린 건축 도면: architecture를 글자 그대로 '건축 도면'으로 본 오답

❌ ③ 뇌가 하루에 소비하는 에너지의 총량: 에너지 소비는 본문과 무관

❌ ④ 뇌를 감싸 보호하는 두개골의 모양: 두개골이 아니라 뇌 내부 구조를 가리킴
det.tip: the physical architecture of the brain changes — 뇌의 물리적 구조(부위 크기·조직)
